paragraphs: Our extraordinary team of dentists deliver excellent dental care for patients of all ages in the Goldsboro community.
Our experienced team of dental professionals is committed to providing exceptional care with the highest standards of clinical excellence and patient comfort.
Comprehensive dental care for every member of your family. From routine cleanings to advanced treatments, we provide exceptional care with the latest technology and techniques.
Our experienced team of dental professionals is committed to providing exceptional care with the highest standards of clinical excellence and patient comfort.

Our Goldsboro office is located near Wayne Memorial Drive and US-70, close to Wayne UNC Health Care and the Berkeley Mall. Patients from nearby neighborhoods like Walnut Creek and Green Meadows enjoy quick access to our practice.

At Riccobene Goldsboro, we combine state-of-the-art dental technology with a compassionate, patient-first approach. Serving families across Wayne County, our office makes maintaining a healthy smile both simple and stress-free.
We believe in the Riccobene Way - a commitment to deliver better dentistry, better experiences and better results with a comprehensive and compassionate approach.
When you help a lot of people you get to some large numbers that we’re proud of - each satisfied patient is another happy smile.
Can't make it to our Goldsboro office? We have other convenient locations in the area to serve you with the same exceptional dental care.
Quality dental care should be accessible to everyone. We offer flexible payment options, accept most insurance plans, and provide affordable membership plans for uninsured patients.
Save money on dental care with our affordable annual membership plans. No insurance? No problem! Get the care you need at a price you can afford.

A wide variety of services are available in our Goldsboro office including general & pediatric dentistry, routine hygiene, emergency dentistry, cosmetic dentistry (including whitening) and dental implants.

Give us a call or schedule an appointment online and we’ll get you on the schedule as soon as possible, often times the very next day that we’re open. At Riccobene, we know that waiting weeks for an appointment sometimes just doesn’t work for your schedule, so we eliminate the wait.
Yes - pediatric dental care is offered at our Goldsboro office.

Yes - we make every effort to fit emergency appointments into the schedule the same or next day. If we absolutely cannot accommodate an emergency appointment, one of our other Riccobene offices may be able to help.
Yes - some implants can be provided at our Goldsboro office. For more complex procedures, we may refer you to a dental surgery facility.
Riccobene in Goldsboro, NC offers cosmetic dental services like Invisalign® and others, as well as veneers, caps, crowns and more.
Riccobene in Goldsboro is located at 2702 Medical Office Place; Goldsboro, NC 27534. We’re open Monday-Thursday 8am-4pm and Fridays from 8am-2pm.

We accept and participate with a large majority of insurance plans. Prior to any treatment, our team will perform a complimentary benefits evaluation to let you know what your insurance covers. We also offer flexible payment options and an affordable dental membership plan for patients without insurance.
Yes - the whole family can visit our office in Goldsboro, NC.

schemaMarkup.reviewBody: My favorite dental office hands down!! Recently moved to the area and the staff has been friendly, welcoming and beyond helpful when it comes my family’s dental needs. The hygienists provides attentive care and sensitivity with the services they provide and the dentists are beyond informative with providing educational support and a relaxed atmosphere. We will continue our care here in great hands.

From check-in, to my actual appointment time with my dental hygienist, my experience was amazing! I not only felt heard by my hygienist, but I felt safe and appreciated. She took her time to explain my dental history, as well as the procedure that would take place, while answering all of my questions with patience. She made sure that I was okay, during the procedure, while letting me know that I was okay. I left with gratitude. Thanks so much!

I had a great experience at Riccobene. The staff was incredibly friendly and professional, and they made me feel comfortable from the moment I walked in. The dentist was thorough, explained everything clearly, and took great care during my treatment. I really appreciate the clean and welcoming environment. Highly recommended to anyone looking for quality dental care!

5/5 stars. This was my first time to the dentist in years, So naturally I was nervous; however, the staff was so friendly and well coordinated I felt so comfortable immediately. I can tell they enjoy working there and as someone who has anxiety about every little detail they put my mind at ease.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
What services are offered at the Goldsboro, NC dental office?

A wide variety of services are available in our Goldsboro office including general & pediatric dentistry, routine hygiene, emergency dentistry, cosmetic dentistry (including whitening) and dental implants.

How do I schedule an appointment in Goldsboro, NC?

Give us a call or schedule an appointment online and we’ll get you on the schedule as soon as possible, often times the very next day that we’re open. At Riccobene, we know that waiting weeks for an appointment sometimes just doesn’t work for your schedule, so we eliminate the wait.

Does the Goldsboro office provide pediatric dental care?

Yes - pediatric dental care is offered at our Goldsboro office.

Is emergency dental care available in Goldsboro, NC?

Yes - we make every effort to fit emergency appointments into the schedule the same or next day. If we absolutely cannot accommodate an emergency appointment, one of our other Riccobene offices may be able to help.

Can I get dental implants at the Goldsboro office?

Yes - some implants can be provided at our Goldsboro office. For more complex procedures, we may refer you to a dental surgery facility.

What cosmetic dental services are offered in Goldsboro, NC?

Riccobene in Goldsboro, NC offers cosmetic dental services like Invisalign® and others, as well as veneers, caps, crowns and more.

Where is the Goldsboro office located and what are the hours?

Riccobene in Goldsboro is located at 2702 Medical Office Place; Goldsboro, NC 27534. We’re open Monday-Thursday 8am-4pm and Fridays from 8am-2pm.

Do you accept insurance or offer membership plans in Goldsboro, NC?

We accept and participate with a large majority of insurance plans. Prior to any treatment, our team will perform a complimentary benefits evaluation to let you know what your insurance covers. We also offer flexible payment options and an affordable dental membership plan for patients without insurance.

Does the Goldsboro office care for dental needs of all ages?

Yes - the whole family can visit our office in Goldsboro, NC.
